description: Source code for VideoFrameSchedulerBase class and its nested PLL class, implementing frame scheduling and VSync synchronization for Android media playback.

classes.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase
classes.description: Handles frame scheduling synchronized with VSync for video playback.

classes.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL
classes.description: Implements phase-locked loop for estimating video frame periods.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL::reset
methods.description: Resets PLL with a given FPS, recalculating period.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL::restart
methods.description: Restarts PLL, resetting sample count and phase.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL::fit
methods.description: Fits a linear model to timestamp samples to estimate period and phase.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL::prime
methods.description: Estimates initial frame rate from timestamp deltas.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL::addSample
methods.description: Adds a timestamp sample and updates period estimation.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::PLL::getPeriod
methods.description: Returns the current estimated period if primed.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::init
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler with a specified video FPS.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::getFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current video frame rate.

methods.name: VideoFrameSchedulerBase::schedule
methods.description: Calculates the optimal render time aligned with VSync and video timing.
